46: Which of the following international organization was in existence before the outbreak of the
Second World War?
A. The OAU B. The League of Nations C. The UNO D. The Commonwealth of Nations
E. ECOWAS
hold_reason: The League of Nations existed before World War II, but the British Commonwealth also existed before the war under earlier constitutional arrangements. The options need a more precise institutional definition for uniqueness.
